meta.title: Granarolo Sustainability 2024 - Summary
meta.description: Educational (unofficial) summary of the Granarolo 2024 Sustainability Report: supply chain, environment, animal welfare, people, community, innovation and waste reduction.

hero.title:
Sustainability Report
Granarolo 2024
hero.subtitle: A guided overview of key topics: supply chain, environment, animal welfare, people and community, innovation and waste reduction.

about.title: Who is Granarolo
about.p1: Granarolo is one of Italy’s leading dairy groups, born from a farmers’ cooperative and developed as an integrated supply chain, from milk production on farms to processing plants and the distribution of finished products.

env.title: Environmental impact
env.p: Monitoring of emissions, energy and water use, with efficiency actions and lower-impact solutions.

people.title: People and work
people.p: Safety, continuous training and welfare initiatives: the value of work is built through clear rules and care.

community.title: Territory and community
community.p: Local partnerships, responsible supply chain and community projects: sustainability is also social and economic.

supply.title: Our milk supply chain
supply.p1: A concise overview of the integrated chain: farming, collection, processing and distribution, with controls and traceability across the main steps.

farmers.title: Farmers
farmers.p: Granlatte cooperative supply chain (475 farmers), with shared standards and improvement programs.

collect.title: Collection
collect.p: Collection and refrigerated transport, with compliance checks and incoming controls.

plants.title: Plants
plants.p: Processing and quality controls throughout production, with procedures and monitoring.

distribution.title: Distribution
distribution.p: Logistics management and distribution to sales channels, with flow traceability.

consumer.title: Consumer
consumer.p: Label information and traceability to support more informed choices.

supply.note: Reference: Sustainability Report 2024 — supply chain description and the Granlatte–Granarolo cooperative model.

pillars.title: Sustainability pillars
pillars.p1: Four areas summarizing the main initiatives: environment, animal welfare, people and packaging.

env.title: Environment and energy
env.p: Lower emissions, more efficient plants and greater use of renewable sources.

animal.title: Animal welfare
animal.p: Shared protocols, veterinary checks and training: prevention and quality on the farm.

people.title: People and work
people.p: Safety, training, equal opportunities and welfare initiatives supporting employees.

pack.title: Packaging and waste
pack.p: More recyclable packaging, less virgin plastic and initiatives to reduce food waste.

pillars.note: Figures and targets summarized from the Group’s 2024 Sustainability Report.

areas.title: Action areas
areas.p1: Key goals and progress status, derived from the 2024 Sustainability Report.

r1.title: Supply-chain biomethane
r1.p: Project to valorize livestock manure and reduce emissions along the supply chain.

r2.title: Supply-chain data platform (xFarm)
r2.p: Collection and monitoring of environmental and farm management data to improve traceability and performance.

r3.title: Animal welfare and certifications
r3.p: Shared standards and audits (Classyfarm/Bonlatte) to assess and improve farming conditions.

r4.title: Packaging: material reduction
r4.p: Actions on weight and packaging materials to reduce plastic and cardboard in 2024.

s3.title: Good health and well-being
s3.p: Food quality and safety, balanced and accessible nutrition.

s12.title: Responsible consumption
s12.p: Circular economy, less waste and more sustainable packaging.

s13.title: Climate action
s13.p: Emission reductions and adaptation measures across the supply chain.

numbers.title: Key numbers 2024
numbers.p1: These figures summarize selected indicators from the Group’s 2024 Sustainability Report.

f1.title: Cooperative supply chain
f1.p: Share of milk purchased from Granlatte members out of the total sourced.

f2.title: Material reduction
f2.p: Overall reduction of plastic and cardboard in packaging materials (2024).

f3.title: Avoided CO₂ (energy)
f3.p: Emissions avoided thanks to Guarantees of Origin for electricity (market-based).
